```diff
+ #!/bin/bash
+ 
+ # Ultra-fast development mode - uses cargo check for rapid iteration
+ # This script prioritizes speed over full compilation
+ 
+ set -e
+ 
+ echo "🚀 Starting ultra-fast development mode..."
+ 
+ # Colors for output
+ RED='\033[0;31m'
+ GREEN='\033[0;32m'
+ YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
+ BLUE='\033[0;34m'
+ NC='\033[0m' # No Color
+ 
+ # Function to run cargo check with optimizations
+ fast_check() {
+     echo -e "${BLUE}📋 Running fast cargo check...${NC}"
+     
+     # Use the ultra-fast check profile
+     CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1 \
+     RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1 \
+     cargo check \
+         --profile=fast-dev \
+         --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml \
+         --message-format=short \
+         --color=always \
+         2>&1 | tee /tmp/juno-check.log
+     
+     if [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 ]; then
+         echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Cargo check passed!${NC}"
+         return 0
+     else
+         echo -e "${RED}❌ Cargo check failed${NC}"
+         return 1
+     fi
+ }
+ 
+ # Function to start frontend in parallel
+ start_frontend() {
+     echo -e "${BLUE}🎨 Starting frontend development server...${NC}"
+     bun run dev &
+     FRONTEND_PID=$!
+     echo "Frontend PID: $FRONTEND_PID"
+ }
+ 
+ # Function to start backend with hot reload
+ start_backend_watch() {
+     echo -e "${BLUE}🦀 Starting Rust backend with hot reload...${NC}"
+     
+     # Use cargo-watch for hot reloading with fast check
+     cargo watch \
+         --watch src-tauri/src \
+         --watch src-tauri/Cargo.toml \
+         --shell 'CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1 cargo check --profile=fast-dev --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --message-format=short' \
+         --delay 0.5 \
+         --clear &
+     WATCH_PID=$!
+     echo "Watch PID: $WATCH_PID"
+ }
+ 
+ # Cleanup function
+ cleanup() {
+     echo -e "${YELLOW}🧹 Cleaning up processes...${NC}"
+     if [ ! -z "$FRONTEND_PID" ]; then
+         kill $FRONTEND_PID 2>/dev/null || true
+     fi
+     if [ ! -z "$WATCH_PID" ]; then
+         kill $WATCH_PID 2>/dev/null || true
+     fi
+     exit 0
+ }
+ 
+ # Set up cleanup on script exit
+ trap cleanup INT TERM EXIT
+ 
+ # Main execution
+ main() {
+     # Initial fast check
+     if ! fast_check; then
+         echo -e "${RED}❌ Initial check failed. Fix errors before starting dev mode.${NC}"
+         exit 1
+     fi
+     
+     echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Initial check passed. Starting development servers...${NC}"
+     
+     # Start frontend and backend in parallel
+     start_frontend
+     start_backend_watch
+     
+     echo -e "${GREEN}🎉 Ultra-fast development mode started!${NC}"
+     echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Cargo check runs automatically on file changes${NC}"
+     echo -e "${YELLOW}🎨 Frontend: http://localhost:1420${NC}"
+     echo -e "${YELLOW}⏹️  Press Ctrl+C to stop all services${NC}"
+     
+     # Wait for processes
+     wait
+ }
+ 
+ # Run main function
+ main "$@" 
```

```diff
- 
+ #!/bin/bash
+ 
+ # Fast build script - only builds when you need to actually run the app
+ # Uses optimized build settings for faster compilation
+ 
+ set -e
+ 
+ echo "🔨 Fast build mode - Building only when ready to test..."
+ 
+ # Colors for output
+ RED='\033[0;31m'
+ GREEN='\033[0;32m'
+ YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
+ BLUE='\033[0;34m'
+ NC='\033[0m' # No Color
+ 
+ # Function to check if we need to build
+ needs_build() {
+     # Check if target directory exists and has recent builds
+     if [ ! -d "src-tauri/target/debug" ]; then
+         echo "true"
+         return
+     fi
+     
+     # Check if source files are newer than the last build
+     LAST_BUILD=$(find src-tauri/target/debug -name "juno*" -type f -exec stat -f "%m" {} \; 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -1)
+     NEWEST_SOURCE=$(find src-tauri/src -name "*.rs" -exec stat -f "%m" {} \; 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -1)
+     
+     if [ -z "$LAST_BUILD" ] || [ "$NEWEST_SOURCE" -gt "$LAST_BUILD" ]; then
+         echo "true"
+     else
+         echo "false"
+     fi
+ }
+ 
+ # Function to run fast build
+ fast_build() {
+     echo -e "${BLUE}🔨 Running optimized build...${NC}"
+     
+     # Use parallel compilation with reduced debug info
+     CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1 \
+     RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1 \
+     cargo build \
+         --profile=fast-dev \
+         --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml \
+         --message-format=short \
+         --color=always \
+         --jobs=12 \
+         2>&1 | tee /tmp/juno-build.log
+     
+     if [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 ]; then
+         echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Build completed successfully!${NC}"
+         return 0
+     else
+         echo -e "${RED}❌ Build failed${NC}"
+         return 1
+     fi
+ }
+ 
+ # Function to start the app after build
+ start_app() {
+     echo -e "${BLUE}🚀 Starting Juno app...${NC}"
+     
+     # Generate constants first
+     npm run generate-constants
+     
+     # Start the app in development mode
+     RUST_LOG=debug bun run tauri dev --no-watch
+ }
+ 
+ # Main execution
+ main() {
+     # Check if build is needed
+     if [ "$(needs_build)" = "true" ]; then
+         echo -e "${YELLOW}🔍 Changes detected, building...${NC}"
+         
+         # Run fast build
+         if ! fast_build; then
+             echo -e "${RED}❌ Build failed. Please fix errors and try again.${NC}"
+             exit 1
+         fi
+         
+         echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Build completed! Starting app...${NC}"
+     else
+         echo -e "${GREEN}✅ No changes detected, using existing build${NC}"
+     fi
+     
+     # Start the application
+     start_app
+ }
+ 
+ # Handle command line arguments
+ case "${1:-}" in
+     --force|-f)
+         echo -e "${YELLOW}🔄 Force building...${NC}"
+         fast_build && start_app
+         ;;
+     --check|-c)
+         echo -e "${BLUE}📋 Running check only...${NC}"
+         CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1 cargo check --profile=fast-dev --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --message-format=short
+         ;;
+     --help|-h)
+         echo "Usage: $0 [OPTIONS]"
+         echo "Options:"
+         echo "  --force, -f    Force rebuild even if no changes detected"
+         echo "  --check, -c    Run cargo check only (fastest)"
+         echo "  --help, -h     Show this help message"
+         ;;
+     *)
+         main "$@"
+         ;;
+ esac
```

```diff
+ #!/bin/bash
+ 
+ # Super fast check - fastest possible validation
+ # Use this for rapid iteration when writing code
+ 
+ set -e
+ 
+ echo "⚡ Super fast check - validating code..."
+ 
+ # Colors for output
+ RED='\033[0;31m'
+ GREEN='\033[0;32m'
+ YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
+ BLUE='\033[0;34m'
+ NC='\033[0m' # No Color
+ 
+ # Function to run the fastest possible check
+ super_fast_check() {
+     echo -e "${BLUE}⚡ Running super fast validation...${NC}"
+     
+     # Use the fastest possible cargo check with minimal features
+     CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1 \
+     RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1 \
+     CARGO_TARGET_DIR="target/check" \
+     cargo check \
+         --profile=check \
+         --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml \
+         --message-format=short \
+         --color=always \
+         --lib \
+         --bins \
+         --jobs=16 \
+         2>&1
+     
+     local exit_code=$?
+     
+     if [ $exit_code -eq 0 ]; then
+         echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Super fast check passed! ($(date '+%H:%M:%S'))${NC}"
+         return 0
+     else
+         echo -e "${RED}❌ Super fast check failed ($(date '+%H:%M:%S'))${NC}"
+         return $exit_code
+     fi
+ }
+ 
+ # Function to run continuous checking
+ continuous_check() {
+     echo -e "${YELLOW}🔄 Starting continuous super fast checking...${NC}"
+     echo -e "${YELLOW}📁 Watching: src-tauri/src/**/*.rs${NC}"
+     echo -e "${YELLOW}⏹️  Press Ctrl+C to stop${NC}"
+     echo ""
+     
+     # Install cargo-watch if not present
+     if ! command -v cargo-watch &> /dev/null; then
+         echo -e "${YELLOW}📦 Installing cargo-watch...${NC}"
+         cargo install cargo-watch
+     fi
+     
+     # Run continuous checking with minimal delay
+     cargo watch \
+         --watch src-tauri/src \
+         --watch src-tauri/Cargo.toml \
+         --shell 'CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1 CARGO_TARGET_DIR="target/check" cargo check --profile=check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --message-format=short --lib --bins --jobs=16' \
+         --delay 0.1 \
+         --clear \
+         --ignore "*.tmp" \
+         --ignore "*.log"
+ }
+ 
+ # Function to check specific file
+ check_file() {
+     local file="$1"
+     echo -e "${BLUE}📄 Checking specific file: $file${NC}"
+     
+     # Basic syntax check using rustc directly
+     rustc --edition 2021 --crate-type lib "$file" --emit=metadata -o /tmp/juno-check.rlib 2>&1 || true
+     rm -f /tmp/juno-check.rlib
+ }
+ 
+ # Function to show timing information
+ show_timing() {
+     echo -e "${BLUE}⏱️  Timing comparison:${NC}"
+     echo "  ⚡ Super fast check:  ~5-15 seconds"
+     echo "  🔨 Regular build:     ~2-10 minutes"
+     echo "  🚀 Full compilation:  ~5-15 minutes"
+     echo ""
+     echo -e "${GREEN}💡 Use super fast check for rapid iteration!${NC}"
+ }
+ 
+ # Main execution based on arguments
+ case "${1:-}" in
+     --continuous|-c)
+         continuous_check
+         ;;
+     --file|-f)
+         if [ -z "$2" ]; then
+             echo -e "${RED}❌ Please specify a file to check${NC}"
+             echo "Usage: $0 --file <path/to/file.rs>"
+             exit 1
+         fi
+         check_file "$2"
+         ;;
+     --timing|-t)
+         show_timing
+         ;;
+     --help|-h)
+         echo "Super Fast Check - Ultra-rapid code validation"
+         echo ""
+         echo "Usage: $0 [OPTIONS]"
+         echo ""
+         echo "Options:"
+         echo "  (no args)          Run single super fast check"
+         echo "  --continuous, -c   Run continuous checking on file changes"
+         echo "  --file FILE, -f    Check specific file only"
+         echo "  --timing, -t       Show timing comparison"
+         echo "  --help, -h         Show this help message"
+         echo ""
+         echo "Examples:"
+         echo "  $0                              # Single check"
+         echo "  $0 -c                          # Continuous checking"
+         echo "  $0 -f src-tauri/src/main.rs    # Check specific file"
+         ;;
+     *)
+         # Default: run single super fast check
+         start_time=$(date +%s)
+         
+         if super_fast_check; then
+             end_time=$(date +%s)
+             duration=$((end_time - start_time))
+             echo -e "${GREEN}🎉 Completed in ${duration}s${NC}"
+             
+             if [ $duration -gt 30 ]; then
+                 echo -e "${YELLOW}💡 Consider using --continuous mode for faster iteration${NC}"
+             fi
+         else
+             exit 1
+         fi
+         ;;
+ esac
```
